Worker Dies in Fall at Rome's Colosseum

A 22-year-old rope access worker died after falling approximately 10 meters (32 feet) while installing lights inside Rome's Colosseum. The incident occurred on Wednesday, leading to the closure of the ancient Roman amphitheater for the remainder of the day as a mark of respect. The Colosseum was closed for the day following the worker's death.
